allowed_conclusion: If SUPPORTED: a scoped better-solver statement for c4_host_v2 hosts from the calibrated families on that panel only. Not better-improver, transfer, novelty or self-improvement.

baselines.comparator: strongest fixed DSL baseline on the SELECT panel (pilot: low_cycle)
baselines.not_a_competitor: the SAT/DRAT reference optimum is evaluator ground truth, not a solver arm

capability_changes: To be filled at freeze: the candidate program and any library changes since the parent version (none exist yet; no candidate is frozen).
exact_claim: A frozen research-generated candidate program scores more edges than the strongest frozen baseline on a custodian-held CONFIRM panel of c4_host_v2 hosts drawn from the adopted calibration, by at least the minimum useful effect, under the registered analysis.
exposure_policy: Custodian-built exposure registry from the public manifest and the campaign export; isomorphism and near-duplicate screening; a CONFIRM panel is retired after its one use.
permissible_information: Candidates see only the candidate view (domain, n, edges). Development may use public DEV panels and SELECT for choosing one candidate; CONFIRM is held by the custodian and never visible before the single analysis.
raw_evidence_custody: Custodian private evidence store (per-task raw receipts); the judge recomputes the analysis from it; the custodian publishes a signed registration log.
rejection_criteria: Any decision-record or plan check failing; registration beyond the declared family size; an INVALID or NOT_SUPPORTED outcome; shared control between roles limits the claim to an operator-attested evaluation.

sample_size_justification.model: headroom-limited integer improvements over centred DEV pilot differences
sample_size_justification.note: pilot effect sizes are reported but never used to set the effect; only spread and headroom are

total_budget.charge: every attempt, retry, timeout and failure
